qualityGate.reason: The test compiles and runs without errors and uses Playwright APIs correctly. However, the selector used to click the product and the URL assertion are somewhat weak and may not reliably verify the correct product detail page. The selector '[data-test="product-1"]' is valid but may be brittle if data-test attributes change. The URL assertion using a regex on /product/ is too generic and does not confirm the exact product page loaded. Test title preserves the testCaseId. There are no asynchronous assertion issues. No hard-coded waits or placeholder URLs are present. The test is minimal and lacks assertions on critical page content, reducing assertion strength.
